name: What should homeowners ask before signing a gut renovation contract?

mainEntity.name: Which questions reveal whether a Los Angeles contractor is prepared for a full gut renovation?
mainEntity.text: Which questions reveal whether a Los Angeles contractor is prepared for a full gut renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before signing a gut-renovation contract, homeowners should ask detailed questions about the contractor’s process. Important topics include who handles permits, how inspections are scheduled, what is included in the quoted price, how allowances work, what happens if hidden damage is discovered, and how change orders are approved. Homeowners should also ask who will supervise the site each day, how the team coordinates trades, and whether the contractor has completed similar projects in the same area. The best answers are specific and backed by examples, not general promises. This conversation helps reveal whether the builder can manage a complex project or is only comfortable with smaller remodels. In a high-stakes renovation, clarity before signing is one of the strongest protections against cost overruns and schedule problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowners should ask about permit handling, contingency, change orders, schedule, allowances, trade coordination, insurance, similar projects, and who manages the site daily. Clear answers show whether the contractor has real experience with complex gut renovations and can control cost and quality.
